Report suspected emerald ash borer
Emerald ash borer has been detected in LaMoure County (9 miles north of Edgeley), Fargo, and Bismarck. If you are concerned about a tree, you are encouraged to report them here.

Bring environmental education to your school or district
Use nature to teach PreK-12 students about math, science, language arts, social studies, and more! Project Learning Tree builds 21st century and STEM skills, fosters social and emotional learning, improves engagement, and introduces students to career paths.

Jamestown Association for Child Care Services
Join us for this hands-on, nature-based learning workshop for early childhood education providers in Jamestown! The workshop will take place on September 14th, 2026
from 6:30-8:30 PM.
SEP. 27, 2026
Teddy Roosevelt Family Day
Families looking for a fun afternoon filled with outdoor activities are invited to attend Teddy Roosevelt Family Day on Sunday, Sept. 27 at McDowell Dam just east of Bismarck. This FREE event runs from 1-4 p.m. There will be many hands-on activities including archery, BB gun shooting, fishing, animal identification, prizes, and more!
